_note: DP2 M0 parameter register. owner_confirm=true -> needs owner decision before M0 freeze. evidence: SPEC/PUBLIC/ASSUMED/DP1(inherited, DP1 evidence applies).

cluster_default.basis: benchmark.md; 1:1 P:D ratio, >=2 nodes per role so that balance/herding is expressible

fabric_model.value: per-node NIC egress/ingress, non-blocking core, max-min fair share

iteration_scheduler.value: decode-first, then FCFS chunked prefill within token budget
iteration_scheduler.basis: vLLM V1-like semantics; verify in M6

kappa_mix.basis: residual inefficiency multiplier on mixed prefill+decode iterations; iteration time itself is composed from DP1 model.py primitives (m0-spec 4.2)

kv_pool_convention.value: HBM KV pool = HBM capacity x hbm_capacity_mult; weights excluded
kv_pool_convention.basis: DP1 convention (CB hbm x0.12 / x0.20 are fractions of full HBM)

external_allocator.value: order hbm(80%) > dram > cxl_pnm > hbf > ssd_pim > custom_hbm (90%)

p_node_state.basis: slide 14 As-Is (D->P history transfer); prefix reuse controlled in Baseline (common-benchmark 3). Reference row P-retain reported separately

prefill_attention.value: GPU only; non-GPU-reachable history is promoted to HBM first (sequential, no overlap); GPU-reachable HBF read in place
prefill_attention.basis: offloaded prefill attention is compute-infeasible on PNM (3.28 TFLOPS); overlap factor sweep optional

gpu_direct_read_efficiency.basis: = system.gpu_bw_eff; layer latency charged once (layers x latency_s)

baseline_decode_semantics.value: GPU attention only; KV outside HBM/HBF is swapped in before decode (blocking, needs free HBM KV pool)
baseline_decode_semantics.basis: DP1 tpot_s As-Is branch, made capacity-aware

telemetry_refresh_s.basis: same mechanism for C1 and C2 (llm-d style metrics scraping)

node_queue_cap_tokens.basis: 2 x token budget; beyond it requests wait in the global queue (this is where C2 plan age arises)

decision_cost_ref_s.unit: s per decision at K=64 candidates (2P+2D, 4 decode tiers), linear in K
decision_cost_ref_s.basis: scheduler (C1) is a single server; C2 planner workers parallel. K_ref=64 = 4 prefill nodes x 4 (node,tier) decode candidates x ... see m0-spec 6.1

validation_cost_s.basis: C2 Late Validation, serial at dispatch

backup_candidates.basis: C2 ranked list kept in plan cache

estimator_error_eps.basis: default exact estimator; sweep per SKILL H17

cost_definition.value: Cost (v2, SLO-fractions) = TTFT_est/SLO_TTFT + TPOT_est/SLO_TPOT + handoff stall/(N_out-1)/SLO_TPOT + externality (running decodes at n_p, resident decodes at n_d, later arrivals at n_p) all in SLO-fractions; constraints: n_d KV capacity, TTFT_est<=SLO, TPOT_est<=SLO; none feasible -> min violation
cost_definition.basis: m0-spec 6.2 (v2). v1 (E2E seconds + externality seconds) mixed TTFT seconds with decode seconds that have loose SLO; changed before any candidate-vs-baseline evaluation, see results/iterations/loop-log.md iteration 0

session_defaults.value: out 256, 8 turns/session, tool wait lognormal(median 10 s, sigma 0.5), horizon 300 s, warm-up 30 s, >=1000 measured turns (extend up to 1800 s)

load_rule.value: lambda0 = 0.6 x lambda_sat(Baseline), frozen after M1 control runs; grid x{0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,2.0}, extended until Baseline goodput peaks

cb_load.basis: CB fixes batch 32; peak extension rule applies

capacity_fit_demotion.value: promotion into a full HBM pool demotes LRU idle sessions to the next tier with space; link time consumed (DP1 link_interference principle); not a DP1 policy
capacity_fit_demotion.basis: needed for physical consistency; boundary item with DP1

step_coalescing.value: iteration-level for N<=8 nodes; coalesce 10 iterations for N>8; equivalence check at N=8 within 2% on P50 TTFT/TPOT

metric_defs.value: TTFT = first token at end of prefill on n_p minus arrival; TPOT_req = (t_done - t_first)/(N_out-1); request meets SLO iff TTFT<=2 s and TPOT_req<=50 ms
